$comment: Draft from docs/portfolio.md, 'Contracts'. Ownership rule 2: a confirmed value lives in the client hub's facts store; this document says what measurement has found and which values a person confirmed.
title: truth/1
description: What the company's own numbers say about an ad platform's: per campaign type, the coefficient between the platform's results and the internal ones, the break-even ROAS and how far the platform's numbers can be trusted. measurement writes it; operators read it before they act on a platform's numbers.
x-rules: A platform and campaign_type pair appears once.
A value with confirmed false is a finding, not a fact: an operator may show it and must not act on it as if a person had confirmed it.
An absent optional key means unknown, never null and never an empty string.

producer.description: The pack that wrote the document (its CLI word).

produced_at.description: When the document was written: ISO 8601 with its zone.

truths.description: One row per platform and campaign type measurement has looked at; empty when none.

campaign_type.description: The campaign type, in the operator's words (for example search, shopping, feed_video).

coefficient.description: What to multiply the platform's reported conversions by to get the company's own count.

break_even_roas.description: The return on ad spend at which the campaign type neither makes nor loses money.

trust.description: How far the platform's numbers for this type can be acted on.

basis_from.description: First day of the data the values rest on, YYYY-MM-DD.

basis_to.description: Last day of the data the values rest on, YYYY-MM-DD.

confirmed.description: True when a person confirmed the values and they are in the hub's facts.

fact_key.description: The hub fact key that holds the confirmed value, when confirmed is true.
